name: LogMeIn Resolve
description: The modern successor to the LogMeIn/GoTo Assist brand (rebranded from GoTo Resolve in Jan 2025) — an all-in-one IT management suite combining remote support, unattended access, helpdesk ticketing, patch management, and endpoint monitoring in one console.

Wayland Unattended Access.comment: Linux isn't in the officially listed supported OS set at all (Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, ChromeOS)

Session Recording.comment: Records on-screen support session activity; higher-fidelity annotations/recordings available as a paid add-on

Microphone Passthrough.comment: VoIP audio for talking with the end user is offered as a paid add-on

Pre-Login Access.comment: Runs persistent "Background Access" for unattended support and deploying updates while users work

No Account Required.comment: Access is tied to a licensed GoTo/LogMeIn account

2FA / MFA.comment: Multi-Factor Authentication is an explicit account security feature

Linux X11: Host.comment: Not part of the officially supported device platforms

Linux: Client.comment: Browser-based access likely works even though Linux isn't an officially supported host platform

Android: Host.comment: Android devices are explicitly managed as endpoints through the UEM console

Web Browser: Client.comment: Sessions can be joined via link/browser; a fully "Zero Download" end-user experience is a paid add-on

NVIDIA RTX 4090.comment: An IT management/support tool, not a GPU-accelerated streaming tool

Free Tier.comment: "Start for Free" tier exists, with a credit-based system for higher-usage features

Personal: Monthly.comment: Business/IT-team focused pricing, no dedicated personal-use tier

Team / Business: Monthly.comment: Starting price varies by source/promo; billed per technician seat

Enterprise.comment: Adds SSO, Zero Trust access controls, mass device deployment, advanced reporting/activity logs
